name: TrialExhibitManager
tagline: Exhibit lists, objections, rulings and trial binders – from pre-marking to the courtroom, in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete trial exhibit management app for litigation teams: plaintiff, defendant and joint exhibit lists with party prefixes and next-free numbers, Bates parsing with duplicate and overlap checks, exchange deadlines with leave of court, objections with grounds, responses and one-click rulings, sponsoring witnesses and witness kits, trial binders with auto-assigned tabs and page capacity, and a courtroom view to offer exhibits and record rulings by trial day.
features: Party prefixes (PX/DX/JX) and next free exhibit number
Duplicate number, invalid Bates and Bates-overlap detection
Exchange deadline checks with leave of court
Objection grounds, responses and rulings (overruled, sustained, limited purpose)
Sponsoring witnesses and witness kit export
Trial binder auto-assign with tab and page capacity
Courtroom mode by trial day with Find by number
Bulk witness, binder, copies-ready and status changes with undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
controlType: standard (TrialExhibitManager data-set control + TrialExhibitManagerPortal field control)
